title: The name on every quote that leaves this desk
caption: Jordan Yates - matching travellers with the right ships since 2011.
brief: Jordan's engraved portrait stamp, centred on white - composed 4:5 from public/portrait-engraved.png.

text: Behind BON V is one advisor, not an agency floor.
sub: One person, one file, and a direct line that gets answered - from your first note to the flight home.

items.head: Cruise, only
items.body: Ocean, river and expedition - ships are the whole trade here, not a sideline of general travel.

items.head: A Virtuoso practice
items.body: In partnership with Luxury Cruise Connections - consortium access and negotiated fares.

items.head: At this since 2011
items.body: Years of sailings, ship visits and kept notes, every one of them working on your shortlist.

title: The job, as I hold it

quote: Honest counsel on ships, seasons and itineraries - including which celebrated ones to skip.

text: You bring the leaning. I come back with three worth your time.
sub: With each, the why - the ship, the season, the cabin, and a fare negotiated so you never pay retail.

title: Tell me where you're leaning
body: A region, a month, a ship you half remember - write or DM, and a shortlist follows. Candid, complimentary, signed with my name.
